## E. How I intend to answer on the stand

So that you can correct me now, these are the lines I have prepared on the points most likely to be pressed:

| Point | My answer |
|---|---|
| Why the sale is void | Cesar sold to a buyer outside the class his authority allowed. The SPA confined any sale to holders of a Llamanzares contract to sell, after consulting the co-owners. She held none; we were never consulted. |
| "The SPA let him sell" | He could execute the documents and receive the proceeds, but only for a sale to that class. (Subject to A2.) |
| Revocation | Revoked 15 August 2005 (Exhibit "F"); published 2020 (Exhibits "G"/"G-1"). The revocation was never annotated. The date does not change that she was outside the class. |
| "The title showed his SPA; she relied on it" | Yes, the annotation was there. An annotation tells you an SPA exists; to rely on it you have to read it, and it limits the sale to the Llamanzares class. |
| Cesar's death (2017) | He died after the 2016 deed. The sale is void for want of authority, not because he later died. |
| Did Cesar sign the deed? | As in Part D. |
| How do you know it was revoked? | From the documents: the 2005 SPA to Ida Buenaventura, and the 2020 publication. |
| Cesar's 2017 "confirmation" | It confirms a sale of land it says was registered in the names of my mother and her two sisters. His signature does not change who owned it. |
| The typos | Yes, those are typos. The deed says 29 September 2016; the title says 28,891. Clerical errors, not lies. |
| Standing | I act under my mother's written power of attorney (Exhibit "A"), and any co-owner may bring this action. |
| Possession, improvements, taxes | I can't speak to who built what. Improvements go to compensation, not title. Nothing was registered until November 2021; I learned of the sale in late 2022, and we acted. |
| Owner's duplicate | I don't know who held it. I have never seen it. My mother's 2023 affidavit of loss says the administrators never turned the duplicates over to the family. |
| Her affidavit | Unless admitted: "I'm not aware that affidavit has been admitted, so I won't testify from it." |
| Other matters, settlement, motive | This case is about the void sale of my mother's lot. Other matters are not before this court. Settlement is for the parties and counsel. |
| Anything I don't know | "I'd need to check that." |

I will not volunteer legal conclusions, will not speak to what Cesar, my mother or her sisters knew or intended, and will defer the legal effect of the SPA's wording to you and the court.
